## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? Link an issue if there is one. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] Feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation only (`docs:`)
- [ ] Chore / refactor / tests

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title (e.g. `feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`)
- [ ] Behavior SSOT: code/tests updated; docs link to implementation (no paraphrase drift)
- [ ] If this changes public usage or config keys → `docs/guides/build_and_config.mdx`
- [ ] If this settles a design trade-off → ADR in `docs/decisions/`
- [ ] Ran `dart analyze --fatal-infos` (or `just lint`) and `just check-contracts` locally when feasible
